summary: Digital Asset Acquisition Corp. (SPAC) filed an 8-K postponing its extraordinary general meeting from July 31 to August 14, 2026, to vote on its proposed business combination with Old Glory Bank, a Delaware corporation. Redemption deadline for IPO Class A shares passed July 29, 2026. Shareholders of record July 7, 2026 remain eligible to vote. Proposals unchanged per definitive proxy statement. Company continues proxy solicitation prior to meeting. What to watch: shareholder approval outcome, redemption levels affecting trust proceeds, and regulatory closing conditions for the de-SPAC transaction.
